```yaml
name: Lint

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'challenges/**'
      - 'scripts/**'
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'challenges/**'
      - 'scripts/**'

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  python-lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install black isort flake8
      - name: Run black
        run: black --check .
      - name: Run isort
        run: isort --check-only .
      - name: Run flake8
        run: flake8 .

  cpp-lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install clang-format
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y clang-format
      - name: Run clang-format
        run: |
          find . -regex '.*\.\(cpp\|hpp\|cu\|cuh\|c\)' -print0 | xargs -0 clang-format -n -style=file

  mojo-lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Find Mojo files
        id: find_mojo
        run: |
          if find . -name '*.mojo' | grep -q .; then
            echo "exists=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "exists=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi
      - name: Install Mojo
        if: steps.find_mojo.outputs.exists == 'true'
        run: |
          pip install mojo
      - name: Run Mojo lint
        if: steps.find_mojo.outputs.exists == 'true'
        run: |
          find . -name '*.mojo' -print0 | xargs -0 mojo --check
```
